Interview Transcripts CSE 2024 session

Introduction
This compilation is a small e ort by our community at @csetranscripts to make CSE preparation a
little more open and accessible for everyone. What started as a simple idea — to freely share
interview transcripts instead of letting them be sold or gatekept — has now grown into a
collective tradition.

Each transcript here was voluntarily shared by aspirants who appeared for the interviews, purely
to help those who’ll walk this path next. This document is not perfect or neatly arranged, but it
carries the genuine e ort of hundreds of aspirants and the spirit of community learning that
defines CSE prep.
If this helps you in your upcoming journey for CSPT-2025, we’ll consider our purposeful filled.
When your turn comes, do send your transcript too — so that the circle continues.

With gratitude,
Team @csetranscripts

Interview Date - 7 Jan
Board- Shri BB Swain Sir
DAF Keywords- Meerut, IIT Bombay, ECE, Cricket, kabbadi, NCC, Paper of AI and ML, Following
world affairs
Chairman Sir
Congratulated me on reaching interview stage. then asked

- How you are feeling today? Asked me whether you are happy or disappointed that your
interview is on 1st day.
- Directly said about whats happening in cricket now a days apart form the game. (he was hinting
about Rohit Sharma PR issue).
- Out of cricket and kabbadi, which one you like most ? Why?
- History of kabbadi and mahabharat relation? few technical speci cations and rules?
- if you have to change one rule o cricket?
- maximum run a player can score in an over ?
(here i was thinking of jhethalal answer of scoring 50 runs 😅 )
- India should reconsider its decision not to play cricket in Pakistan for the Champions Trophy ?
Possible implications?
- Few counter questions but seems satisfied with my answers

Member 1:
- about women in constituent assembly ?
- corruption in judiciary ? Any law in place to address this ?
- New Zealand parliament performed a haka to protest a controversial bill? Bill is about?
Community name ?
- classical language new ones ? schedule 8 related question
- Bangladesh crisis and what india should do now ?
- Recent south korea crisis ? possible implications? role of north korea
Member 2:

- NCC me kya sikha ? Don't you think it should be made compulsory?
- Question on semiconductor ? How i organised that semianar?
How i arranged that much fund and follow up questions ?
- India target in electronic manufacturing ? And current status? Is india lagging behind?
Why china is world leader in this ? What india can learn ? India loosing ground etc
- Questions of spectrum auctioning ?
- Tell me about any most memorable moment of your iit days?
Member 3:

- AI vs ML ? Use of AI in Warfare?
- Content of my paper published (AI) (Seems very interested in this topic. asked multiple
questions on this)
- what is LLMs ? Don't the posses threat to individual security ?
- Is it possible to train them emotionally ?
Member 4:

- Have you ever attended mahakumbh?
- How up govt using AI to manage crowd in mahakumbh?
- Question on India-Canada diplomatic relation?
- Asked me to name european country where india have visa-free access?
-Question on recent UP investor summit and Meerut developmet prospect

Member 2
- Question in Fit India Movement.
- Then why actors/cricketer moving towards politics ?
The board was very cordial. Giving me ample time to think and respond, even giving me cues and
encouraging me like "ha aur socho". Extremely opposite of any mock interviews.
I would say my interview is mostly based on DAF. Although some questions seems like current
affairs based but since world affairs keyword is in my Daf so i consider those questions related to
my daf only.

**Mock Interview - Don't have much time so took only 3 mock - Samkalp, Chankya & Vajiram. i
would suggest to give atleast 3 mock to get the hold of interview. Mocks were mainly helpful for
non-verbal cues. Content wise i don't feel that mock will help you much because some mocks
were too factual for me and some were very generic.

**One to One Session with Rahul Sir (IAS PCS Pathshala).
He spent almost 2 hours with me. His insights were excellent on how to answer questions and
generate point and manage situations when you don't know the answer.
Since my interview is mainly daf based his daf discussion in detail and provided potential
interview questions on extracurricular activities were incredibly helpful for brainstorming different
dimensions.
I highly recommend everyone to have at least one session with him.

Lastly I would like to thank this community for their continuous support and valuable transcripts.
🙏

Board-- Suman Sharma mam
Date- 21 January 2025- afternoon
Keywords- B. E- ECE, history optionals, IPS first preference, fitness instructor as profession
My observations

Chairperson-

1. No qustions from optionals.
2. Board wants an organic interaction and they try to ask questions for which we dont have a pre
designed answer.
3. I personally feel that going straight to interview, without mocks helped me being organic.
( Disclaimer-- Im a bit good in english and thus didnt need practice for speaking... Completely
personal opinion)

my 2nd class degree.
1.) Why Tamilnadu despite having long coastline, has no beaches like goa?
2.) Whats the difference between type 1 and type 2 semiconductor?
3.) Why indian IT sector is more focussed on support and less oriented towards coding and
development?
4.) Whats the largest chip making company?
5.) How do you perceive EGO.. ?
6.) What has the government done so far to improve semicon manufacturing?
Answer-- Went with 75,000 crore National semicon mission and PLI scheme
7.) Why did the mission not go as planned?
Answer-- wonderfully answered this part with all technicalities and foxcon- vedanta issue..
Mam was satisfied and also provided additional inputs.

Member1
1.) Again in electronics and communication.
2.) Difference between ios and Android.
3.) Whats GPU?
4.) Why python language is preferred in software industry?

Finally i frankly spoke about my lack of experience in B. E-ECE, as Iam working in fitness industry
for nearly 7 years, with a smile in a humble tone.
Board then shifted away from electronics.
But except 1 question, answered all questions decently.. Now into general topics
Member 1
1.) How can we skill our people?
2.) Long monologues about
our workforce quality and asked measures for it.
3.) What is the way forward in health education?
Answered -- we have warnings for alcohol and tobacco but not for sugar. Sugar is 300 times
more addictive than cocaine and its also available to children.. School should be the functional
unit for health education was my point

2.) How do you gauge the fitness level of a person
Answer- -- most engaging answer by me based on BMI, VO2 MAX, etc...
3.) Why qatar is the mediator for most negotiations?

Member 2
( most cordial and seated close to me) - started questions from my expertise
1.) What does a fitness instructor and trainer actually mean?...

Answer-- also my best answer.. Was a great conversation in this topic.
Sir seemed pretty much satisfied and passed over

Member3( lady member)
Mam was very stern looking at begining.. She didnt even laugh.. But after she started
questioning, she was the most jovial... Had a very engaging and entertaining conversation ..
1.) Tell me the dance forms of India.
- I asked whether she referred to classical dances and she said yes. .. Continued with the 8
classical dances of india...
2.) Then asked me to name famous personalities from each dance..
-- Went with vishwaroopam lm reference and named [name]...Said that Birju maharaj
was the G. O. A. T because he taught kamal sir kathak in just 5 days and made him give a master
performance.... Mam was very engaging..
3. Why dont you teach yoga as a fitness instructor?
Answer-- said i learnt basic yoga at school.. But not a certified yoga trainer. So I prefer
resistance training, as I have working experience in it.

Member 4( very strict member)
1.Talked about corruption in police department... Whenever i was about to answer, Sir would
interrupt me and give counterarguments.....
2.) Sir would never accept my arguments that said corruption in police is very less compared to
other departments and now after technology enabled policing, it has reduced even further.

Talked about delhi police prepaid taxi service in airport.
Only after that sir was like ok. Was very smooth according to me. Dont know how much time it
took.. It was very engaging.
Did not attend a single mock interview as I did not have much time.
Focussed on just being myself and had a humble, honest, transparent way of interacting.
Medical board instruction
1.) Please check your ear and have your wax removed.. Otherwise you must reappear after 7 days

like me... Its disastrous for candidates from south india , to travel back

2.) Better avoid eating dinner after interview... I had a late night snack and it spiked by glucose
levels in the morning test... Luckily they rely on HbA1c and thus I was saved.

Chairperson: Mrs. [name]
DAF Keywords: Gujarat, Mehsana, Unjha, PSIR, Cricket, Weight Training, BBA, Gujarat Youth
Parliament

Chairperson:
1. So you are from Gujarat, Mehsana district. Tell me few things for which Mehsana is known for.

5. What are its advantages and disadvantages?
6. In recent times, there has been upsurge in Water contracts. What are Water contracts? What
are its implications on Water security?
7. Can water contracts benefit a country like India?

M1:
1. What are the contributions of different sectors in India's GDP?
2. Does the figures you mentioned make up 100%? Doesn't it go beyond 100-150%? (He
misunderstood Primary sector as 70-80% instead of 17-18%)
3. What steps would you suggest to boost manufacturing?
4. What Electoral reforms would you suggest in the current election mechanism?
5. Any more?

M2:
1. Asked me to explain some random Management concept (heard it for the first time)
2. What do you think of India's current taxation system?
3. (After 30-40 seconds of answering) No no, I am asking about the Indirect taxation?
4. What is regressive tax?
5. Has Government made any changes in Indirect taxation to provide relief to lower sections?
Give me specific examples of the past 3-4 years.
6. How much is the Corporate Tax rate in India?
7. On What income it is applicable?
8. What is MSP?
9. Do MSP falls under subsidy?

1. Tell me about tenets of Indian Foreign Policy.

1. Recently in Gujarat, there has been a new ancient archaeological site related has been found.

Thank you, your interview is over.

Interview was mostly based on Random topics, factual data, minimum focus on current affairs,
minimum DAF related and Zero questions on Hobbies and Achievements.

The environment inside the interview room was very serious, no smile on panel members' face.
Duration : 25-30 minutes
Mocks: Vajiram, Samkalp, Chahal, Next IAS, OnlyIAS (All were good in some or the other way)
The experience of Mocks vis-a-vis real interview was very different in my case.
One to One: Vajiram (Ravindran Sir), Chanakya Mandal (Avinash Dharmadhikari Sir) - both were
very beneficial

members seemed very interested in my answers. It felt more like a discussion rather than a
traditional question answer session.
Mock Interview - Since this my 4th interview. So i attended only 2 mock interview - Samkalp and
Chahal.
Based on my experience I can say that if it is your first interview you should give at least 5-6
interviews to boost your confidence. Otherwise 2-3 interviews are sufficient.

One to One - I attended more 121 than mock interview.
121 with
- Satyam Jain - Avoid this.
- Ravindran Sir - Recommended. Discussed variety of question and it will help you.
- Rahul Sir (ias pcs pathshala) - Highly Recommended. Very much beneficial for structuring and
concluding the answer. Sir value addition part was extremely enriching.
- Dharmadhikari Sir - Recommended. Very helpful in confidence boosting.

In a real interview, questions from mock sessions and onetoone discussions will not get repeated
but the approach you develop will help you answer random questions. (However I got a bit lucky
as 3 questions I had discussed with Rahul Sir were repeated - caste census wala, BiharJharkhand, and sports section wala🙂 )

I believe you should try to articulate your answers in an engaging manner. Avoid giving just 1-2
line responses. Show enthusiasm and eagerness in every answer. Try to cover multiple
perspectives using succinct keywords.

Lastly all the best to everyone and thanking this channel for providing transcript. It was very much
helpful 🙏

1. Constitution Article which allows for PIL ?
2. Difference between Shrimad bhagwad gita and bhagwad gita ?
3. It is such a revered book , Recently a controversy erupted regarding teaching of religious book
in school.
What is your view ?

But then is it truly universal or is it influenced by human cultural perspectives?

✅ Member 3
1. Stampede in Kumbh Mela. As a DM, how you have avoided that ?
2. Don't you think adminstration se ye sare steps already liye the ? Then why such disaster
happend ?

✅ Member 4

interview is over.

All mock interview were good. They will definitely give you valuable learning but don't don't lose
your genuine personality.
✅ One on One - Rahul Sir of IAS PCS PATHSHALA and Dharmadhikari Sir.
I deeply thank both of them especially rahul sir for his input on articulation of answer and
explaining the nitty gritty of answering🙏

To sum up the experience i would say although it is called a personality test..you need to be well
prepared for it. The panel will have 30 minutes to judge your personality and in the same way you
will also have those 30 minutes to showcase the aspects of your personality that work in your
favor.

no questions related to IRS or the budget were being asked. However Rahul Sir advised me to
prepare them since they were part of my DAF and eventually questions from those areas did
come up in my interview. So the bare minimum you can do is to prepare your DAF well...focus on
what is in your control. Control the controllable.
Wishing Everyone all the best. ❤
